task_a.how_you_would_do_it_on_your_device: Click the three dots at top right of browser, tap 'Select all', then tap 'Copy'.
task_a.problems_you_notice_in_the_pasted_text: It has header/footer and unrelated links; not just the job description.
task_a.why: I prefer to keep only the useful part, but copying all is quick and I can trim later.

task_b.message_1_means: The posting you saved might not be the latest version.
task_b.message_1_why_it_appeared: JobHub checks for updates and warns you if the copy is older than 7 days.
task_b.what_you_would_do: I’d copy the text again from the website and paste it back into JobHub to refresh the data.
task_b.message_2_means: The job’s application deadline has already passed, so it might be closed.
